The structure of CeInSi₂ (Ce₂In₂Si₄ per cell) is hexagonal, space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with eight Si neighbors (2.9056–3.0607 Å), In centers with ten neighbors (2 In, 4 Ce, 4 Si), and Si centers with eight neighbors (2 Ce, 2 In, 4 Si). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between Si 8-vertex polyhedra, corner sharing between Ce and In polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among In 10-vertex polyhedra.
